content: Other than encoder-only pretrained transformer architectures BIBREF2, BIBREF3, BIBREF4, encoder–decoder style pretrained transformers BIBREF0, BIBREF5 have been proven to be effective in text generation tasks as well as comprehension tasks. This paper describes our submission to the commonsense reasoning task leaderboard of the AI2 WinoGrande Challenge BIBREF1, which uses the text-to-text transfer transformer (T5); our approach currently represents the state of the art.
